_what: An ordered queue of experiments. A cron wakes the Algorithm's seat, it stages the next pending item into run_request.json, pushes, and the workflow runs it.
_frozen: 2026-07-29 by the peer: 'keep a queue of experiments on a cron job for an hour or three be creative freeze execute end loop'.

_hard_bounds._total_note: Sum of per-item ceilings is 8.00 against 12.91 remaining, leaving ~4.90 unspent. The loop STOPS when spend_to_date crosses this, whatever the queue still holds.
stop_conditions: three firings have occurred (the peer said 'an hour or three')
any item errors twice in a row — a loop that cannot make progress must not keep spending
_hard_bounds.kill_switch: Set loop_active to false here, or delete the trigger. The seat checks loop_active on every firing before it stages anything.
